title: pvAnnotateSelection
body:
## pvAnnotateSelection

Adds a string array named "Annotate Selection" to the points or cells of Input, labelling each element selected by node i of the Selection with Labels[i] and every other element with DefaultLabel. Use it to tag regions (e.g. inlet, outlet) for colouring or export. The output is the input dataset with the extra array.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- The number of Labels must equal the number of selection nodes; otherwise ParaView warns and the output stays empty.
- Only POINT or CELL selections whose nodes hold element indices are labelled; convert other selection types to INDICES with pvConvertSelection.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `AnnotateSelection`. Identity: `filters/AnnotateSelection`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input from which the selection is extracted. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |
| `Selection` | Required data input for the native Selection port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: The input that provides the selection object. Accepted data: selections (vtkSelection). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkSelection"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `DefaultLabel` | Specify the default label used for unlabelized data. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `Labels` | Associated for each selection node an label. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |

```json
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input",
    "Selection": "UPSTREAM_Selection"
  }
}
```
